in_telugu.long_meaning: Ramavobodesha Chandra, Rama who is the god of the Moon.

in_marathi.name: Ramchandr
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramchandr हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram means 'God' and Chandra means 'moon'. Ramchandr is a name of Lord Rama, who is considered to be the god of gods in Hinduism. He is the embodiment of power, strength, and courage.

in_bengali.name: Ramchandr
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Gods
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ramchandr একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ram means 'God' and Chandra means 'moon'. Ramchandr is a name of Lord Rama, who is considered to be the god of gods in Hinduism. He is the embodiment of power, strength, and courage.
